vuFileTools - Introduction

vuFileTools is a developer library containing more than 200 ready-to-use Windows utility functions. It gives Clarion developers a practical way to handle common Windows tasks without writing and maintaining their own Windows API wrappers.

The library covers files and directories, disk information and compression, Windows and system information, program and process launching, network information, registry access, shortcuts, string manipulation and data conversion, interprocess communication, and more. Functions have their own reference pages with calling information and Clarion examples.

You can explore the entire A–Z function reference or find the capability you need in Functions by Category.

Version 5 capabilities

vuFileTools includes enhancements to program-launching functions, file and directory operations, and buffer-aware string replacement. The CSTRING Sizes and Buffer Capacity guide explains how to choose caller-side buffers and understand function-specific limits.

Window Dimming is an additional feature in Build 212. When enabled, it can automatically dim a browse behind its update form or a parent behind a standard Clarion message. It also offers configurable appearance, manual controls, START support and customizable message procedures. Window Dimming is off by default so existing vuFileTools applications retain their familiar behavior. See the Window Dimming guide for the one-checkbox setup and the required Windows manifest.

Getting started

Begin with Installation and Template Registration. Then consult Using the Template, the function reference, or the category directory.
